description:
Welcome to a simple and chill watchparty live stream! I recently spent months of my life getting summoned to secret discord calls and google slides to participate in a DnD style adventure game created by @MagicTheNoah everyone's favourite evil games master who torments youtubers :D 

After having a chat with noah I felt it would be fun to do a stream and watch along with this episodes and react to its many moving parts. Then he made the video 9 hours long and here we are about to embark on a really really bad idea :D I do of course find a few ways to exploit this situation for my benefit.
Be warned this game is designed to be impossible and no creators are meant to survive....
